description: This file is a shell script library ('git-mergetool--lib') that provides functions for working with Git merge tools. It is intended to be sourced by other scripts to set up merge tool related functionalities, such as retrieving merge tool info, commands, paths, initializing merge tool setups, and running merge tools. It includes documentation and function definitions specific to Git merge tool integration.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Returns a merge tool name, indicates if guessed with return code 1 or 0, and can consider '$GIT_MERGETOOL_GUI' for GUI tools.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Returns the custom command for a specified merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the custom path for a specified merge tool.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up merge tool specific functions to be used or overridden.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches a specified merge tool with the given context, using '$MERGED', '$LOCAL', '$REMOTE', and '$BASE'.
